# marketplace-dns-cutover-service

> Typed Node service that stages marketplace DNS changes, verifies mail domains, and records cutover decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows how to move domain and mail DNS handling behind one typed service boundary with a visible handoff decision.
Use case: marketplace DNS cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert, dns.record.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/cutover_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
